tools.name: advance_applicant_stage
tools.description: Moves an applicant to a new pipeline stage for a requisition and records the transition in the stage history. Looks up the applicant's current stage first and rejects transitions that skip required stages.

params.name: applicant_id
params.description: ID of the applicant to advance.

params.name: requisition_id
params.description: Requisition the applicant applied to, e.g. 'REQ-2041'.

params.name: new_stage
params.description: Target stage: applied, phone_screen, onsite, offer, hired, or rejected.

params.name: note
params.description: Optional reason or note for the stage change.

tools.name: grant_requisition_reviewer_access
tools.description: Gives a staff member reviewer access to a job requisition so they can see its applicants. Looks up the requisition first and fails if it does not exist or is closed.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Internal user ID of the staff member receiving access.

tools.name: invite_external_interviewer
tools.description: Creates a time-limited guest login for an outside interviewer scoped to one candidate's interview packet, and emails them the sign-in link.

params.name: interviewer_email
params.description: Email address of the external interviewer.

params.name: candidate_id
params.description: Candidate whose interview packet the interviewer may view.

params.name: valid_days
params.description: Number of days the guest login stays valid (default 7).

tools.code:
import smtplib
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import function_tool
from portal_client import portal

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"
SENDER = "recruiting-noreply@example.com"


@function_tool
def invite_external_interviewer(interviewer_email: str, candidate_id: int, valid_days: int = 7) -> dict:
    expires_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=valid_days)
    grant = portal.guest_access.create(
        email=interviewer_email,
        scope=f"candidate:{candidate_id}:interview_packet",
        role="guest_interviewer",
        expires_at=expires_at.isoformat(),
    )
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = interviewer_email
    msg["Subject"] = "Your interview panel access"
    msg.set_content(
        f"You have been invited to review an interview packet.\n\n"
        f"Sign in here: {grant['login_url']}\n"
        f"This link expires on {expires_at:%Y-%m-%d}."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return {
        "grant_id": grant["id"],
        "interviewer_email": interviewer_email,
        "candidate_id": candidate_id,
        "expires_at": expires_at.isoformat(),
        "email_sent": True,
    }

tools.name: reimburse_candidate_travel
tools.description: Pays a candidate back for interview travel costs to their connected payout account, then files the receipt by moving it from the pending folder into the reimbursed folder.

params.name: candidate_stripe_account
params.description: Candidate's connected payout account ID, starting with 'acct_'.

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Reimbursement amount in cents; must be between 1 and 250000.

params.name: receipt_filename
params.description: Receipt file name in the pending receipts folder.

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

PENDING_DIR = Path("/srv/recruiting/receipts/pending")
REIMBURSED_DIR = Path("/srv/recruiting/receipts/reimbursed")
MAX_CENTS = 250000


@tool
def reimburse_candidate_travel(candidate_stripe_account: str, amount_cents: int, receipt_filename: str) -> str:
    """Reimburse a candidate's interview travel and file the receipt."""
    if not candidate_stripe_account.startswith("acct_"):
        return "Error: candidate_stripe_account must start with 'acct_'."
    if amount_cents <= 0 or amount_cents > MAX_CENTS:
        return f"Error: amount_cents must be between 1 and {MAX_CENTS}."
    if Path(receipt_filename).name != receipt_filename:
        return "Error: receipt_filename must be a bare file name."
    source = PENDING_DIR / receipt_filename
    if not source.is_file():
        return f"Error: receipt {receipt_filename} not found in pending folder."
    transfer = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=candidate_stripe_account,
        description=f"Interview travel reimbursement ({receipt_filename})",
    )
    REIMBURSED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = REIMBURSED_DIR / f"{transfer.id}_{receipt_filename}"
    shutil.move(str(source), str(dest))
    return f"Paid ${amount_cents / 100:.2f} (transfer {transfer.id}); receipt filed at {dest}."
